issues.description: In the UML/problem statement, the abstract class Ride defines the char attribute "abbreviation" and the tasks require getters for all attributes. In the reference solution, Ride instead declares the field as "shortName" and provides getter "getShortName()". This contradicts the UML naming and can confuse students and/or break tests that expect "abbreviation"/"getAbbreviation()".
issues.suggestedFix: Align Ride with the UML: rename field "shortName" to "abbreviation" and rename getter "getShortName()" to "getAbbreviation()" (and adjust constructor parameter naming accordingly). Alternatively, update the UML/problem statement to consistently use "shortName".
